Setup instructions: Store only the tenant ID in the secret-free template copy used by the test tenant.
Validation procedure: Open Entra admin center and compare the tenant ID with the configuration value.
Pass criteria: IDs match and the value is not a REPLACE_WITH placeholder.
Fail criteria: Value missing, malformed, or still a placeholder.
Expected evidence: Redacted configuration excerpt and portal screenshot reference.

Setup instructions: Create an app registration and record the client ID. Do not commit the secret.
Validation procedure: Confirm the application object ID and client ID in Entra.
Pass criteria: Application exists and IDs match configuration.
Fail criteria: Application missing or secret stored in git.
Expected evidence: App registration properties export with secrets removed.

Setup instructions: Register the blueprint and agent instance so the agent ID differs from the application ID.
Validation procedure: Compare agent ID, blueprint ID, and application ID.
Pass criteria: Three identifiers are present and agent ID is not the application ID.
Fail criteria: Identifiers missing or equal.
Expected evidence: Agent registry excerpt with IDs partially redacted.

Configuration requirement: Grant delegated permissions and admin consent
Setup instructions: Grant the delegated permissions in the matrix that the user workflow requires.
Validation procedure: Read oauth2PermissionGrants or the consent screen.
Pass criteria: Each required delegated permission is granted and admin-consented.
Fail criteria: Any required delegated permission missing.
Expected evidence: Consent screenshot with user names redacted.

Configuration requirement: Grant application permissions only where supported
Setup instructions: Grant application permissions from the matrix. Do not grant Agent365.Observability.OtelWrite as an application permission.
Validation procedure: Compare app role assignments with the matrix.
Pass criteria: Supported application permissions granted; unsupported ones absent.
Fail criteria: Unsupported permission granted or required application permission missing.

Setup instructions: Complete an authorization-code sign-in as a test user.
Validation procedure: Acquire a delegated token and call GET /me with that token.
Pass criteria: GET /me returns the test user and no secret is logged.
Fail criteria: Token acquisition fails or /me is called with an application token.
Expected evidence: HTTP status and token claims with the token itself removed.

Setup instructions: Use client credentials only for application-permission calls.
Validation procedure: Request a token for https://graph.microsoft.com/.default and inspect roles, not scp.
Pass criteria: Token contains roles for granted application permissions.
Fail criteria: Token missing, or delegated scopes used for an app-only call.

Setup instructions: Call protectionScopes/compute for the test user and agent application location.
Validation procedure: Send the reference request body and record executionMode.
Pass criteria: 200 response and an ETag are stored.
Fail criteria: Non-success status or empty error handling that fails open.

Setup instructions: Submit a synthetic prompt marker, not real customer content.
Validation procedure: Call processContent with activity uploadText.
Pass criteria: 200/204 and policyActions interpreted; block stops the model call.
Fail criteria: Model called after a block action.

Configuration requirement: Evaluate the model response with processContent
Setup instructions: Submit the model output as downloadText before returning it to the user.
Validation procedure: Call processContent on the response.
Pass criteria: Block prevents the response from being returned.
Fail criteria: Response returned after restrictionAction block.

Setup instructions: Post metadata only after the decision.
Validation procedure: Call contentActivities and confirm raw prompt text is absent.
Pass criteria: 201 Created and body has no content.data field.
Fail criteria: Raw prompt stored in the audit body or call fails.

Configuration requirement: Configure Azure OpenAI and Agent Framework
Setup instructions: Set endpoint and deployment. Install agent-framework in the tenant environment only.
Validation procedure: Import the package and run one authorized completion.
Pass criteria: Completion succeeds and is traced.
Fail criteria: Package missing or endpoint still a placeholder.
Expected evidence: Redacted completion metadata, not the full prompt.

Setup instructions: Configure tools.allowlist.
Validation procedure: Call an allowlisted tool and a denied tool.
Pass criteria: Allowlisted tool returns data; denied tool returns an authorization error.
Fail criteria: Denied tool executes.

Setup instructions: Run the reference MCP server only on an authorized network.
Validation procedure: initialize and tools/list succeed.
Pass criteria: Only allowlisted tools are advertised.
Fail criteria: Unlisted tool is advertised or callable.

Setup instructions: Install microsoft-opentelemetry and supply a token resolver. Grant delegated OtelWrite or use S2S as documented.
Validation procedure: Start the process and emit a test span.
Pass criteria: Span accepted by the intended backend, or a documented failure is recorded.
Fail criteria: Export failure is ignored or reported as success.

Setup instructions: Store the connection string in a secret store.
Validation procedure: Confirm the resource exists and a local span can target it.
Pass criteria: Resource ID matches configuration.
Fail criteria: Connection string committed or resource missing.

Configuration requirement: Deploy the APIM policy in a non-production gateway
Setup instructions: Parameterize tenant and application IDs. Keep deploy off until reviewed.
Validation procedure: Send a request without a token and with a valid test token.
Pass criteria: Unauthenticated call is rejected; valid token reaches the backend.
Fail criteria: Policy contains a secret or fails open.

Setup instructions: Enable Defender for Cloud Apps Microsoft 365 activities.
Validation procedure: Run the CloudAppEvents and AlertInfo queries for one day.
Pass criteria: Queries parse and return a result set, including an empty set.
Fail criteria: Query fails because a column or table is absent.
Expected evidence: Hunting result count and any schema error.

Configuration requirement: Confirm Sentinel workspace and analytics rules
Setup instructions: Enable connectors for SigninLogs, AuditLogs, and Microsoft Graph activity.
Validation procedure: Run getschema for each table, then deploy rules only if columns match.
Pass criteria: Schemas match the detection files and rules are enabled only after review.
Fail criteria: Column mismatch or rules deployed while disabled-by-default flag is ignored.
Expected evidence: getschema excerpt and rule deployment output.

Setup instructions: Follow REPLACE-SYNTHETIC-EVIDENCE.md.
Validation procedure: Hash tenant evidence and obtain reviewer approval.
Pass criteria: Manifest hashes match and reviewer status is approved.
Fail criteria: Synthetic records left labeled as customer results.

Setup instructions: Confirm the Agent 365 license, then call the catalog API.
Validation procedure: GET /copilot/admin/catalog/packages.
Pass criteria: 200 and a package collection, or a documented license error.
Fail criteria: Call reported as success without a status code.

Configuration requirement: Keep secrets out of the repository
Setup instructions: Use a secret store for client secrets, API keys, and connection strings.
Validation procedure: Scan the repository for connection strings and private keys.
Pass criteria: No live secret is present.
Fail criteria: Any live secret committed.
